# @trysac/rich-text-model

Framework-free rich text document model with a schema, invertible steps, transactions, mapped selections and a bounded undo/redo history TypeScript library for Node.js 22+, published as ES modules.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and canonical forms
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): acceptance and property tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): scope and objective
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools and constraints
